content.summary: Independent exact enumeration reproduces both requested dropped-constraint diagnostics. They establish relevance to this numerical contradiction, without showing realizability or necessity for every possible proof. Both frozen hashes match.

checks.method: Wrote a fresh integer enumeration using combinations with replacement on degrees 1 through 19, retaining the other bounds and excess budget 58.
checks.observation: Dropping a+b<=34 gives 6,354 tuples and maximum 4640 at (19,19,8,8), with L=26,U=860. Dropping a+b+c<=46 gives 6,280 tuples and maximum 4604 at (17,17,17,9), with L=32,U=906. Both exceed 4488 and violate their omitted constraint. Thus the remaining displayed relaxation alone fails to contradict support>=54. Neither tuple specifies intersections or a realizable family, and these computations do not challenge the complete bound or certify optimality of 53.
